title: Change default behavior for Choice when no otherwise Processor is set
description: In a mule flow, when using a <choice> message router without setting a Processor in the <otherwise> section, and the MuleMessage does not match any of the <when> clauses, an exception is thrown. To achieve a conditional behavior currently mule requires to set a dummy processor on the otherwise clause. One usability improvement would be letting the message be processed by the remaining part of the flow if no <when> clause was matched and no <otherwise> processor provided.
